story.text: Wikido (Wiki道) is the practice of wiki. It is an intentional play on aikido (合気道), the practice of aiki. Consider cross-language wordplay: English "do" and Japanese "do" (道) and Chinese Dao (道). This activity invites participation.
Federated wiki invites the curation of many small gardens in a wiki farm.

In 2015, Mike Caulfield described the practice of digital gardening in a keynote and companion essay for Digital Learning Research Network. He presented gardening as an alternative to the relentless stream of social media. "Federated wiki... radically changed how I think about online communication and collaboration. ...
